Killed by mercenaries. |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} '''Lynae''' is a deceased, mentioned only [[NPC]] and was a [[Fractsidus]] operative prior to her death. Her voice is heard briefly during [[What Burns Beneath Frostlands]] via a recording. ==History== Lynae was a Fractsidus operative set to infiltrate [[Startorch Academy]] in [[Lahai-Roi]] as a spy. At some point before the events of the [[Main Quest]] ''[[When the Unknown Thrums]]'' Lynae was killed by government mercenaries after being deemed a threat by the [[New Federation]]. Her corpse was found by one of the [[Lynae|mercenaries]] targeting her, with said mercenary then taking on her identity and attending Startorch Academy in her place. ==Mentions== {{Character Mentions}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages|Lynae}} ==Change History== {{Change History|introduced=3.0}}
